note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: Tozer's quoted verses, his chapter epigraphs, and the phrases he recites inside his own sentences.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a verse, the inner marks are ‹ ›. Tozer's italics stay on the matching OWB words (Psalm 34:8 taste, Psalm 45:8 smell, John 10:27 hear, Matthew 5:8 see). `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, bare citations, creedal and apocryphal quotations, and Tozer's own paraphrases.

Judgement calls. Matthew 16:24-25 is OWB 'life' (ሕይወቱን), so Tozer's next paragraph names what Jesus called it «ሕይወት», as the English does. Psalm 63:8 'upholdeth' is OWB ይጠብቀኛል, so the following 'upholding' is «መጠበቅ». Matthew 5:5 and 11:29 'meek' are OWB ገሮች/ገር; Tozer's 'this word meek' quotes «ገሮች» with a one-time gloss (የዋሆች), and the chapter's prose keeps የዋህነት. 'Blessed' is OWB «የተባረኩ» (decision pure-in-heart); Tozer's 'He alone could say Blessed' follows it in the same sentence. 'O Lord, Thou knowest' is Ezekiel 37:3, not Psalm 139:4. Hebrews 12:2's run-on quotation becomes OWB's exhortation «…ዘወትር እንመልከት» with the sentence around it reshaped. Exodus 33:18 'show me thy glory' is OWB «እባክህ፣ ክብርህን ልየው», in Tozer's own prayer too. Genesis 22:12 closes Tozer's imagined speech of God; only that closing sentence is OWB.
